== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Rystall (V)|Rystall (V) (Errata)]]: the PC card image of [[Rystall (V)]] (2 December 2025, [[:File:V26-D-rystall.gif|V26-D-rystall.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (page 1). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
